$comment: Intentional Python<->TS divergences. A step listed here is allowed to differ
between the two bindings without failing the parity gate. Keyed by
'<scenario-id>.<step-id>'. Every entry needs a documented reason.
See #30 [V-01] AC3 and docs: TS added an identifier-validation boundary (F-05)
that Python lacks, and two Python-only methods were never ported to TS.

allow.reason: Numeric-formatting divergence surfaced by cypher mode only: Python interpolates the resolution float via str(1.0) -> 'RETURN louvain(1.0)', while TS interpolates via template literal -> 'RETURN louvain(1)' (JS has no int/float distinction; 1.0 === 1). The C core parses both to the same value, so results mode agrees exactly — this affects the emitted Cypher string alone.

#31 [X-01] AC#2: bulk insertProperty routes values by JS runtime type. JavaScript has no int/float distinction (1.0 === 1, Number.isInteger(1.0) === true), so a value written as 1.0 lands in node_props_int, whereas Python's isinstance(1.0, float) sends it to node_props_real. The insert return value (external-id -> rowid map) is identical on both sides; only the storage table differs, which this diagnostic step surfaces. Results-mode only — bulk uses raw SQL and emits no Cypher, so cypher mode captures nothing on either side.

F-05: TS assertIdentifier rejects the interpolated label 'bad-label' with ValidationError before any query; Python interpolates it unchecked and the C core raises a parse error. Different error surface by design.

F-05: TS assertIdentifier rejects the interpolated property key 'bad-key' with ValidationError before writing; Python interpolates it unchecked and the C core raises a parse error. Different error surface by design.
Not ported to TS: Graph.leidenCommunities throws UnsupportedOperationError; Python's leiden_communities depends on the Python-only 'graspologic' package (raises ImportError when absent).
Not ported to TS: no toRustworkx method exists on the TS Graph; Python's to_rustworkx depends on the Python-only 'rustworkx' package (raises ImportError when absent).
